mapper.select: select id, code, name, module, type, status, sort, remark from sys_permission order by sort asc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_permission(id, code, name, module, type, status, sort, remark) values (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{module}, #{type}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update sys_permission set code = #{code}, name = #{name}, module = #{module}, type = #{type}, status = #{status}, sort = #{sort}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select distinct p.code from sys_user_role ur join sys_role_permission rp on ur.role_id = rp.role_id join sys_permission p on rp.permission_id = p.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and p.status = 1
